notes.title: Winter update to version 1.10!
notes.notes:
Winter snowy landscape!
Improved and new sounds!
Improved and new animations!
Advanced graphics settings!
Deer are rarer!
Zombies move faster by 50%!
The probability of finding a ghost has been reduced by 25%!
Improved mechanics melee and ranged!
Winter Easter eggs!
Fixed bugs!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26402614/8d146527c93609f0df4a2d6ea912cf7561aa0a5d.png[/img]

notes.notes:

notes.title: Update to version 1.8!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26402614/6335c8cf22089614d30f75dae845019bc1cf174b.jpg[/img]
Replacement of many textures!
Character model!
New animation!
The balance of the character's stats! (Energy, hunger, thirst)
Change shifts days and nights (Shift is carried out more smoothly modified sun, clouds)
Improved artificial intelligence! 
New mob!
New Easter eggs!
Changed the shotguns. (Now, to shoot you need to aim. Reduced accuracy of firing from a standing position, the increased accuracy from a sitting position)
Replacement of some sounds!
Added new loading screens with tips on the game!
Fixes bugs.
No other significant changes in balance.
Improved detail!
New ranged weapons - revolver!
New tool/melee weapon - shovel!
Additional boxes in the house.
Highlight active items.
Improved lighting from the fire.
Digging the garden with a shovel. (For planting seeds)
Reduced the distance of objects.

notes.title: Update to version 1.8! / Обновление до версии 1.8!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26402614/6335c8cf22089614d30f75dae845019bc1cf174b.jpg[/img]Replacement of many textures! / Замена многих текстур! 
Character model! / Модель персонажа! 
New animation! / Новые анимации!
The balance of the character's stats! (Energy, hunger, thirst) / Баланс статистики персонажа! (Энергия, голод, жажда).
Change shifts days and nights (Shift is carried out more smoothly modified sun, clouds) / Изменение смены дня и ночи (Смена осуществляется более гладко, изменено солнце, облака).
Improved artificial intelligence! / Улучшение искусственного интеллекта! 
New mob! / Новый моб! 
New Easter eggs! / Новая пасхалка! 
Changed the shotguns. (Now, to shoot you need to aim. Reduced accuracy of firing from a standing position, the increased accuracy from a sitting position) / Изменена стрельба из ружья. (Теперь, что бы стрельнуть нужно прицелится. Сниженная меткость стрельбы из положения стоя, увеличенная меткость из положения сидя) .
Replacement of some sounds! / Замена некоторых звуков! 
Added new loading screens with tips on the game! / Добавлены новые загрузочные экраны с подсказками по игре! 
Fixes bugs. / Фиксы багов.
No other significant changes in balance. / Прочие не значительные изменения в балансе. 
Improved detail! / Улучшение детализации! 
New ranged weapons - revolver! / Новое оружие дальнего боя - револьвер! 
New tool/melee weapon - shovel! / Новый инструмент/оружие ближнего боя - лопата! 
Additional boxes in the house. / Дополнительные ящики в доме. 
Highlight active items./ Подсветка активных предметов. 
Improved lighting from the fire. / Улучшенное освещение от огня. 
Digging the garden with a shovel. (For planting seeds) / Вскапывание огорода лопатой. (Нужно для посадки семян) 
Reduced the distance of objects./ Снижено расстояние использования предметов.

notes.title: Upgrade to version 1.6!
notes.notes:
Fixed saving furnace.
+ 2 new sections in the book.
Now in the repair of objects filled scale of karma.
The zombies even stronger.
Reduced melee weapon damage bonus.
Added support for French keyboard layout.
